name: SubtitleCat
description: Search and download subtitles from subtitlecat.com.
overview: Search and download subtitles from subtitlecat.com. No account or API key required.
changelog: 1.0.5.0 - Rank and filter subtitlecat results by the site's own quality signals (user rating, download count, file size) and require a distinctive title match, so unrelated same-year films are no longer downloaded; offer one result per language to stop .0/.1/.2 duplicate subtitle files.
